stripNote: A pack's "strip" is optional. "native": true = the picture was made for the 4032x284 dashboard strip at its own pixels (a panorama stitched at no more than 1:1, never an enlarged crop). "ownerKept": true = an enlargement the owner has seen on the car and asked to keep. The launcher offers a strip only with one of the two marks; a pack without a strip entry dresses the other screens and leaves the strip as it is (ADR-073).
